Input paths resolve against the spec's folder, output paths against --out-root (default: the spec's folder). The other shape - extending an approved hand-authored page - is documented under _extend_shape_example.

_field_notes.output_html: the diagram page this spec writes
_field_notes.source_html: extend shape only: the approved hand-authored page - read, never modified (hash-checked); the output may not overwrite it
_field_notes.new_boxes[]: id, label, href required; sublabel, css_class (default box), status (fixed vocabulary; status_color hex is a parity override only), edges_to. width/height are MINIMUMS: the text wraps and the box grows
_field_notes.new_boxes[].row: blank canvas: preferred - each row's height is its tallest box, rows never overlap, the canvas auto-sizes; never mix row and y in one spec
_field_notes.new_boxes[].x: manual horizontal placement (branching is your call); a growing box keeps its centre. A snake: row 0 left to right, row 1 right to left, the row change a vertical edge between two boxes with the same x
_field_notes.new_boxes[].y: extend shape: explicit y (you place into someone else's artwork); only the height grows there
_field_notes.viewbox: OPTIONAL [w, h] floor for the auto-sized blank canvas
_field_notes.viewbox_grow_height: extend shape: extra height added to the approved page's viewBox
_field_notes.css_from: blank canvas: the parent's .css or .html whose stylesheet is reused (never hand-copied)
_field_notes.build_py: OPTIONAL parent build script exposing CSS, md_to_html(md), nav_html(current); then a leaf may set nav_current and the spec nav_postprocess [[old, new], ...]
_field_notes.css_addition / css_insert_after_marker: extra CSS; extend shape inserts it after the marker (else before </style>)
_field_notes.caption / text_replacements: extend shape: a caption under the new boxes; [{old, new}] replacements, warned when not found
_field_notes.back_link / leaf_back_link / leaf_pages[: {href, label}: every page below the top has a visible way back; only the true root sets "root": true
_field_notes.legend: default true: the shared status legend (one definition, ladder_common.py); an extended page's own <div class="legend"> is swapped for it
_field_notes.leaf_pages[]: output_html, title, status, pending, source_md (preferred: rendered from the raw source, never copied) or body_md, md_replace [[old, new]] to re-base links, placeholder_kind when there is no content, nav_html or leaf_nav_html, srcline
